title: Content Item Envelope (v1)
description: The one interface between a brand's source adapter and the BrandCortex core. Everything the generation engine needs is denormalized here; the core never reads a brand's raw tables. Treat this as versioned — evolve by publishing v2, not by editing v1.

content_id.description: Stable id owned by the brand. BrandCortex references it and never mints its own. For ThaiSwim this is the `card_renders.id` cuid — not a UUID, so the type is a plain string.

brand.description: Tenant key, e.g. "thaiswim". A keyed column, not a tenancy subsystem.

source_type.description: Brand-defined item kind, e.g. "swimmer" or "event" for ThaiSwim (mirrors `card_renders.kind`). The core treats this as an opaque label used for alternation and feature attribution.

locale.description: BCP-47-ish locale driving the generation branch, e.g. "th" or "en".

asset.description: How to obtain the image. Exactly one of `render_url` or `storage_key` must be present. ThaiSwim renders on demand and needs no bucket; a future brand that writes PNGs to shared storage would use `storage_key` instead.

render_url.description: Public, CORS-open URL that renders the image deterministically from its query params. Fetched at publish time. NOTE: a live render reflects data at fetch time, so it can drift from the `facts` captured at draft time — compare before publishing (see docs/thaiswim-integration.md).

storage_key.description: Key within a shared asset bucket, for brands that persist rendered images instead of rendering on demand.

height.description: Omitted when the render height is variable. ThaiSwim swimmer cards are a fixed 1080x1350; event cards are 1080 x (452 + rows*130 + 176).

canonical_link.description: The link this post points at. UTM params are appended by the core, not the adapter. Goes in the FIRST COMMENT, never the post body.

facts.description: Denormalized, brand-shaped facts the generation engine renders from. Free-form by design: the core passes it to the brand's voice templates without interpreting the keys. For ThaiSwim this is `card_renders.snapshot` verbatim — resolved server-side from the same builders the PNG uses, so it is by construction what the image displayed. `wow_factor` (0..1) is the one generic hint the core does read, for opportunity scanning; the adapter computes it.

generated_at.description: When the brand rendered the item (`card_renders.createdAt`). Means 'content generated / available' — never 'posted to channel', which is BrandCortex's own state.
